summary: On the control/style-transfer endpoint, how much of the input image's composition survives the restyle: the layout and placement of subjects, as distinct from style_strength, which governs how strongly the style image is applied. Stability's default is 0.9.
combines: Style transfer has three independent dials: style_strength for how much style comes across, composition_fidelity for how much of the original layout is kept, and change_strength for how much the original is allowed to change overall.
Lixpi sends style_strength (pinned to 1) but not this one, so style transfer currently runs at Stability's 0.9 default with no way to loosen the composition.
note: Make sure add a help tooltip value explaining all that in the ui.
